findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: catalog_read, youtube_transcript_scraper, email_auth_dmarc_spf_check, domain_expiry_registration_check, dns_health_check, on_page_seo_audit, erc20_token_intelligence, craigslist_local_market_search, x402_seller_endpoint_check · Private data: email_auth_dmarc_spf_check, dns_health_check, lookalike_domain_finder, dex_token_market_snapshot, erc20_token_intelligence, evm_wallet_token_tracer, sec_edgar_company_filings, x402_seller_endpoint_check · Public sink: catalog_read, page_to_markdown_safe, youtube_transcript_scraper, email_auth_dmarc_spf_check, domain_expiry_registration_check, dns_health_check, ai_crawler_access_test, on_page_seo_audit, broken_link_checker, lookalike_domain_finder, package_dependency_risk_scanner, dex_token_market_snapshot, erc20_token_intelligence, evm_wallet_token_tracer, craigslist_local_market_search, sec_edgar_company_filings, x402_seller_endpoint_check.
